description: The agents-tui village in the Omarchy bar: how many agents are working, what waits on you, and each swarm's houses, gate and pipeline in a panel.

barWidget.description: Live swarm status from an agents-tui server: the swarms, then one village's houses, flow, what needs you and its features. Right-click opens the full village.

schema.label: Village
